headline: Africa's solar capacity surges 54% in record 2025
meta_description: Africa installed solar capacity at its fastest rate ever in 2025, with eight countries each exceeding 100 MW and nearly half from rooftop systems.

body:
Africa's solar installations grew 54% in 2025, marking the fastest year on record for the continent's renewable energy expansion.

The growth reflects a shift in how solar reaches communities across Africa. Eight countries each installed more than 100 MW of capacity during the year, while nearly half—44%—of all new installations came from rooftops and other distributed systems rather than large centralized plants. This decentralized approach puts power generation directly in the hands of households and local businesses, offering a path to energy access that doesn't depend solely on grid infrastructure.

The momentum signals accelerating momentum in Africa's energy transition, as costs continue falling and solar technology becomes more accessible to individual users and smaller projects across the continent.
